Recommend Optimal Local LLM Configuration for Workstation or HPC Hardware

Source: R/benchmark.R
recommend_runtime_config.Rd

Computes hardware-aware local model sizing, quantization, context window, concurrency (batch_size), KV-cache precision, and hardened container memory limits given available GPU VRAM, host RAM, GPU count, corpus size, and average document length. Evaluates open-weights parameter tiers (3B, 8B, 14B, 32B, 70B) against estimate_vram_requirements() so research labs avoid GPU out-of-memory failures on lab workstations and HPC Slurm nodes.

Usage

recommend_runtime_config(
  vram_gb,
  ram_gb = 32,
  n_gpus = 1L,
  n_docs = 1000L,
  avg_tokens = 800L,
  priority = c("balanced", "accuracy", "throughput"),
  backend = c("ollama", "llama.cpp", "vllm"),
  safety_margin = 0.88
)

Arguments

vram_gb

Non-negative numeric VRAM per GPU in gigabytes (e.g., 16, 24, 48, 80; pass 0 for CPU-only workstations).

ram_gb

Positive numeric host system RAM in gigabytes (default 32).

n_gpus

Positive integer number of GPUs allocated (default 1L).

n_docs

Positive integer expected corpus row count (default 1000L).

avg_tokens

Positive integer average tokens per input document (default 800L).

priority

Optimization goal: "balanced" (default), "accuracy" (favors larger parameter count and higher precision), or "throughput" (favors higher concurrent batching and faster quantized weights).

backend

Target local container runtime: "ollama" (default), "llama.cpp", or "vllm".

safety_margin

Numeric VRAM utilization ceiling in (0.5, 0.98] to leave headroom against CUDA fragmentation (default 0.88).

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_runtime_recommendation" containing hardware, workload, recommended (list of optimal settings and container memory limits), vram_estimate (airgap_vram_estimate), candidates (ranked feasible tibble), and rationale (character vector).

Examples

recommend_runtime_config(vram_gb = 24, ram_gb = 64, n_docs = 5000L, avg_tokens = 1200L)
#> <airgap_runtime_recommendation> [backend=ollama, priority=balanced]
#>   Hardware:        1x 24 GB GPU (24 GB total) | 64 GB RAM
#>   Recommended:     14B open-weights (Q8_0)
#>   Context / Batch: 4096 tokens | batch_size=4 | KV=FP16
#>   Est. Memory:     18.10 GB (75.4% utilization)
#>   Container Spec:  gpu='nvidia', memory_limit='27g', shm_size='2g'
recommend_runtime_config(vram_gb = 80, n_gpus = 2L, priority = "accuracy", backend = "vllm")
#> <airgap_runtime_recommendation> [backend=vllm, priority=accuracy]
#>   Hardware:        2x 80 GB GPU (160 GB total) | 32 GB RAM
#>   Recommended:     70B open-weights (FP16)
#>   Context / Batch: 4096 tokens | batch_size=4 | KV=FP16
#>   Est. Memory:     137.04 GB (85.7% utilization)
#>   Container Spec:  gpu='nvidia', memory_limit='24g', shm_size='6g', TP=2
